+# Auth0 MVP Workflows - Design Document
+
+## Scope
+This MVP provides automated Auth0 identity management through Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling teams to deploy OIDC applications and manage users via GitHub Actions workflows. The MVP supports secure credential management and role-based access control.
+
+**Core Capabilities:**
+
+Auth0 tenant configuration with security policies
+OIDC application deployment (Grafana integration)
+User management through programmatic APIs
+
+## Infrastructure Configuration
+
+### Architecture Overview
+```
+GitHub Actions → Terraform → Auth0 Platform
+      ↓              ↓           ↓
+   Workflows      IaC Modules   Resources
+```
+
+**Workflow Structure:**
+- **Tenant Setup:** Two-job workflow (plan → apply) for tenant-level resources
+- **Application Deployment:** Single-job workflow for OIDC applications
+- **User Management:** Go-based tool execution
+
+**Resource Organization:**
+- Tenant module: Machine-to-machine clients for API access
+- Applications module: OIDC clients, roles, and Auth0 Actions
+- Separate modules enable independent lifecycle management
+
+## APIs and Integrations
+
+**Auth0 Management API v2:**
+- Authentication via Machine-to-Machine client credentials
+- Rate limiting: Standard Auth0 API throttling applies
+
+**Terraform Auth0 Provider v0.50:**
+- Resource management through declarative configuration
+- Handles API authentication and error handling
+- Variable injection through GitHub Secrets
+
+**Go SDK Integration:**
+- github.com/auth0/go-auth0 v1.4.1 for user management operations
+- Context-aware API calls with proper error handling
+
+## Security Considerations
+
+**Credential Management:**
+- GitHub Secrets for sensitive configuration
+- Auth0 M2M client credentials with least-privilege scopes
body: Can you expand on which scopes in particular you'd need?

+    - This does come with the downside of accessibility be more difficult (less options) and storing recovery codes may be necessary.
+
+## Edge Cases and Error Handling
+
+**Configuration State Conflicts:**
+- GitHub protection rules prevent concurrent executions
body: This is about using concurrency protection in the workflow to ensure only one instance of the workflow runs at a time and queues new runs. I'll add some details in the doc.
